## Requirements (contract)

1. Immutable preregistration + safe sampling: preregistered campaign (frozen source snapshot,
   explicit target population, sampling frame, inclusion probabilities, strata, grouping,
   split assignment, seed, ruleset identity); lineage/component-disjoint partitions — no
   entity/component/copied-mirrored-observation/republisher lineage crosses train-test;
   persistent denominators; sealed holdout identifiers; manifest tamper detection.
   (SIG-EVAL-001)
2. Independent blinded labels: append-only `same` / `different` / `insufficient_evidence`
   reference labels with pseudonymous reviewer identity, evidence refs, reason codes; separate
   adjudication; first-pass views hide model tier/score, prior labels, other reviewers and
   model predictions; insufficient persists and never auto-accepts; reference labels distinct
   from operational `accept`/`reject`. (SIG-EVAL-002)
3. Packets: reviewer rubric, training/pilot packet, pseudonymous provisioning instructions,
   measured-time worksheet, human marker packet. Recruit nobody; run no agent-as-human
   campaign; invent no labels/reviewers/attestations.
4. DB: additive campaign/sample/assignment/attestation/reference-label/adjudication schema +
   sqitch deploy/revert/verify + plan entry; PG/RLS/tier-token access; payload hashes +
   label watermark; sealed labels unreachable from operational clustering and model-development
   views until authorized unsealing; append-only supersession; `sig_materialize` gets no sealed
   access; reversible migration deletes no history.

## Acceptance criteria → test matrix

| # | AC | Planned test |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Seeded repeated sampling identical; no entity/component/republisher lineage crosses split; manifest tampering detected | `test_human_eval.py`: same seed → identical draw; dependency-group partition disjointness (shared upstream id / republisher family / mirror group / neighborhood); digest mismatch on tampered row |
| 2 | Two reviewers cannot see each other's first-pass labels or model predictions; insufficient persists, never auto-accepts | `tests/db/test_human_eval.py`: RLS per-reviewer isolation (reviewer role sees own labels/assignments/packets only; sample internals forbidden); `insufficient` persisted + consensus never yields operational accept |
| 3 | Zero human labels → campaign prepared/provisional; P31 operational review compatible | `campaign_state` returns prepared/provisional with 0 labels; P31 `review_item`/`review_decision` untouched (PG compat test) |
| 4 | Real PG: role-isolated reads/writes, append-only supersession, denominator persistence, zero sealed-label access from clustering; reversible deploy, no history deletion | `tests/db/test_human_eval.py`: grants matrix (`sig_materialize`/`sig_read_public`/`sig_export`/`sig_ingest` denied on eval tables; `sig_eval_reviewer`/`sig_eval_admin`/`sig_eval_custodian` scoped), immutability trigger, released-view seal until authorized unseal, manifest denominator recomputation, dedicated-container sqitch revert asserting eval tables gone + claim/review history intact |
| 5 | Verification green; meaningful tests; requirement ids stamped; owned DEFERRALS rows; ADR; authorized closeout | `make check` + `make test-db` + docs tools + this ledger + ADR-128 |

## Plan

- `db/deploy|revert|verify/human_eval_campaign.sql` + `db/sqitch.plan` entry:
  - `sig.human_eval_campaign` (design JSONB + protocol/ruleset/frame digests; one manifest digest),
    `sig.human_eval_manifest`, `sig.human_eval_sample` (opaque sample ids, partition, estimand,
    stratum, dependency group, lineage ids, `selection_probability`/`weight`/`draw_order`,
    `reference_basis`), `sig.human_eval_packet` (blinded payload + digest),
    `sig.human_eval_assignment` (reviewer × sample × pass), `sig.human_eval_attestation`
    (human-marker events incl. human_identity — required FK for labels),
    `sig.human_eval_label` (append-only, `same`/`different`/`insufficient_evidence`,
    `supersedes_label_id`, `label_digest`, `packet_digest` pinning the packet seen),
    `sig.human_eval_adjudication` (append-only, allows `unresolved`),
    `sig.human_eval_release` (authorized unsealing decision, scope-gated).
  - Roles: `sig_eval_admin` (prepare: SELECT+INSERT on prep tables, released-label view only),
    `sig_eval_reviewer` (RLS-scoped: own assignments/packets/labels + INSERT label+attestation),
    `sig_eval_custodian` (sealing authority: SELECT all + INSERT release/adjudication).
    `sig_materialize`/`sig_read_public`/`sig_export`/`sig_ingest` get NO eval-table grants;
    `sig_materialize` gets SELECT on `human_eval_label_released` only (sealed rows can never
    appear there). Immutability triggers on every eval table (owner refuses UPDATE/DELETE too;
    `session_replication_role` carve-out mirrors `publication_dispositions` for sqitch revert).
- `resolution/src/resolution/human_eval.py` (pure): canonical manifest digest,
  `build_dependency_groups` (union-find over entity neighborhood / shared upstream ids /
  republisher family / mirror group), deterministic `assign_partitions`,
  `draw_eval_sample` (per-stratum seeded draw, selection probability = n/N per stratum,
  weight = N/n, draw order, opaque `hev-…` sample ids), `build_blinded_packet`
  (orientation randomization + field neutralization; forbidden-field scan),
  `label_watermark`, `verify_manifest`, `consensus`, `campaign_state`, gold-label adapter.
- `resolution/src/resolution/human_eval_pg.py`: PG writers/readers under SET ROLE.
- `resolution/src/resolution/cli.py`: `sig-resolution eval` group (prepare / packets / assign /
  status / export / import-labels / attest / adjudicate / unseal / verify).
- `docs/evaluation/`: `reviewer-rubric.md`, `training-pilot-packet.md`,
  `reviewer-provisioning.md`, `measured-time-worksheet.md`, `human-campaign-marker.md`, README.
- Tests: `tests/resolution/test_human_eval.py` (pure) + `tests/db/test_human_eval.py` (real PG).
- Memory: ADR-128 + spec_src row + regenerated spec; BACKLOG/COVERAGE updates; closeout edits
  (BUILD_INDEX, LEDGER, PHASE LOG, DEFERRALS annotation, `docs/build/pr/P32.9.md`).

## Context notes

- P31.10 `camera_site_review`/`review_pg` stays the OPERATIONAL review path
  (`accept`/`reject`, proposals carry model evidence). P32.9 does not fork it: reference labels
  live in a new schema surface with a different vocabulary and are never written as
  `review_decision` rows. `insufficient` has no operational import path at all.
- `sig_materialize` is NOLOGIN/NOBYPASSRLS/non-superuser and inherits `sig_read_public` —
  it must get zero grants on the eval tables; the released view is its only (and always
  sealed-filtered) read surface.
- P32.2's `sig.immutability_guard()` trigger pattern is the immutability convention.
- Round-9 draft `P31.18` (re-derivation from human holdout) is moved to Round 10 — this ticket
  is the tooling prerequisite, not the re-derivation itself.
